headline: Approved updated grant guidelines and priorities and the May 20 minutes; set MaldenCulturalCouncil.org as the website URL.
summary: Members reviewed a MACFest recap, grant reimbursements, and newsletter and website updates. They approved updated guidelines and priorities and the May 20 minutes. They decided the website URL would be MaldenCulturalCouncil.org.

plain_text:
Malden Cultural Council 
August 27, 2026 
 
In attendance were Jim Genzale (Treasurer), Jen Kuhnberg, Lexi Mason, Zoe Moss, Leilani Ricardo, 
Edward Rocha (via Teams), and Sue Tufts (Chair) 
 
The meeting was called to order at 5:40pm by Sue Tufts. 
 
Topics and Discussion 
• Welcome, roll call, and introductions 
o Lexi Mason and Zoe Moss gave brief introductions since this was their first board 
meeting 
o Ed Rocha introduced himself because he had not met Lexi or Zoe previously  
 
• Approval of May 20 meeting minutes: A motion to approve the minutes was put forth 
(Leilani Ricardo), seconded (Jen Kuhnberg), and approved.  
 
• LCC Guidelines and Priorities:  
o The results of our 2026 community survey had been previously distributed (see 
attachment) 
o We reviewed the results, noting that many of our current guidelines and priories still 
had community support 
o Some changes include that applications need to be for events taking place in the 
calendar year after the grant application period ends (January 1-December 31 of the 
following year), and we added types of programs that are now priorities based on the 
community survey 
o After making updates to the Guidelines and Priorities document and reading it in full 
for the board, a motion to approve the updated guidelines and priorities was put forth 
(Leilani Ricardo), seconded (Jim Genzale), and approved. 
 
• MACFest Recap:  
o Jen Kuhnberg reported that our second MACFest was a success with higher 
attendance, great growth and more participation 
o Despite the success there were still challenges on the financial reimbursement side 
o It was suggested that we create a Standard Operating Procedure to define the full 
reimbursement process and some language used by the City’s Purchasing/Finance 
team 
 
• Treasurer’s Report: 
o Jim Genzale reported that we’ve reimbursed around $15k of FY26 grants so far; nine 
grants have been reimbursed and six are in progress 
o As a reminder, we awarded 38 grants in total so still have many more to reimburse 
 
• Social Media/Online Presence Update:  
o Lexi Mason reported that our first ever email newsletter was sent to around 200 
addresses and had a 25% open rate, with many readers clicking through to links in 
the newsletter 
o It was suggested that we add a Linktree to our Instagram page so folks could sign up 
for the newsletter 
o Zoe Moss reported that we are building a simple WordPress website 
o After discussion it was decided that the URL would be MaldenCulturalCouncil.org 
 
The meeting was adjourned at 7:10 PM by Sue Tufts.
